title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Radhe is a lecturer on law for Harvard’s Negotiations Workshop, where she teaches dispute resolution and value-creation tools to law students. She is interested in the application of negotiations theory to policy development, grassroots organizing + coalition-building, international relations, public-private partnerships, and other political dealmaking applications.
